item: A repair refusal's words are scrubbed where they enter a record or a log (R138): exception_text in both run() handlers, the last exc_info allowance gone, repair.py in the sink sweep, a source reading of what each refusal is made of
summary: Declined and SalvageRefused words reached two log lines and reason_text (the boot-sequence status and the Diagnostics bundle) unchanged; every producer says a fixed sentence today, nothing kept it so. run() now writes them through exception_text(refusal, typed=False) before any cut, the re-raised Declined is made of the scrubbed words, the exc_info allowlist is empty, repair.py joins the sink sweep, and tests/test_refusal_detail_source.py reads every producer (a caught exception only as its class, a fixed label of a driver error, or the words of our own refusal classes). A planted passphrase is absent from the log, repair.snapshot(), boot_sequence.snapshot(), the bundle builder's copy, the job row, the raised refusal and the registry's records; 9 scrub-removal mutants killed.
